previous.changeLog: Persisted local customization IDs across restarts, cleaned deleted assets from saved outfits, improved JSON save reliability, recalculated local-asset usage automatically, and repositioned the overlay button when the interface changes.

current.changeLog: Improved Camo Selector startup handling by waiting for the native customization cache before probing customization items, preventing harmless early-startup cache errors from appearing in the client log.

previous.changeLog: Version 1.0.4 comes with a safe guard optimization for calling certain heavy engine method too frequently. It might increase average FPS a little.

current.changeLog:
Version 1.0.5 comes with big refactor, that significantly improves performance during battle (especially when combined with other mods).
Basically keeping performance very close to vanilla game, even through tick-rate is boosted significantly.

On average, reduced performance overhead by 50% - 60% (that's 2x - 2.5x faster code!), especially when aiming at a tank.

When mod is combined with Dispersion Reticle mod, performance overhead is reduced by 75% on average (that's 4x faster code!).

IMPORTANT: If you use Dispersion Reticle mod, then update it to newest version (at least version 3.1.8) - without it, additional reticles won't receive reticle responsiveness from this mod.

previous.changeLog: Version 3.1.7 comes with fix for stuttering in sniper view when aiming at tank, when armor penetration indicator mods are present

current.changeLog:
Version 3.1.8 comes with:
* adjustment to changes of Responsive Reticle mod in version 1.0.5
* reduced mod performance overhead by 30% on average (that's 40% faster code!)
* refactored few annoying code fragments

IMPORTANT: If you use this mod together with Responsive Reticle mod, you MUST update Responsive Reticle mod to version 1.0.5 as well.
Otherwise Dispersion Reticle won't properly react to reticle responsiveness.

Also - using both together, reduces performance overhead by whooping 75% (that's 4x faster code!).
